description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/phone/format (base $0.002; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?number=%2B14155552671 (or national digits with country=US; one number per call). Phone number format check for one number: valid or not for its numbering plan, region, country calling code, number type (mobile, fixed line, toll free...) and E.164, international, national and tel: URI forms. Offline numbering-plan data; does not show that a line is in service or who holds it, and is not a carrier lookup. A completed check is charged whether valid or not. Unparseable input: not charged. USDC on Base only.
